game: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991, Mega Drive REV01)
target: Original Sega Mega Drive/Genesis REV01 cartridge build, played through PC emulation

areas.name: Green Hill Zone
areas.location_cue: A bright grass, palm trees, checkerboard cliffs.
areas.note: Explore each act's fixed side routes before advancing; use emulator states as the cartridge's reversible safety net.

save_backup.title: Create an emulator save state before the exit
save_backup.why: The cartridge has no native save file, and leaving this zone closes its missed routes and pickups.
save_backup.detail: Keep a named state at the current act start and another before any giant ring or outgoing transition until this area's checklist is reconciled.

point_of_no_return.title: The outgoing transition closes this area
point_of_no_return.why: Normal play cannot travel backward into an earlier act.
point_of_no_return.detail: Complete every local secret and planned Special Stage attempt before crossing the final marker or opening the exit capsule.

levels.1: Protect your ring count and inspect nearby side paths before crossing this act's finish.
levels.2: Reach the end marker in Act 1 with 50 rings whenever you still need a Special Stage attempt.
levels.3: Finish the act with at least 50 rings and avoid taking a late hit. After the sign spins, the giant ring appears for only a short window; enter it if this is one of your scheduled emerald attempts, or pass it deliberately if preserving a later branch.

levels.1: A decorative object near an early bridge is less solid than it looks.
levels.2: After the first bridge, jump into the second palm tree on its right.
levels.3: Cross the opening bridge, pass the first palm, and jump upward through the trunk of the second. Strike the concealed monitor inside to take its temporary protection before moving on.

levels.1: Your first rotating maze rewards patience more than speed.
levels.2: Enter the first giant ring, follow the narrow passage, then leave the large ring chamber through its left phantom barrier.
levels.3: Carry at least 50 rings through the first act's finish and enter the giant ring. In the maze, pass through the ring-filled room, drift left through the transparent blocks, and stabilise inside the small chamber. Avoid its two exit tiles while repeatedly pressing against one section of the diamond shell until a gap opens; touch the emerald in the centre.

levels.1: The obvious route passes below a reward placed on familiar scenery.
levels.2: Take Act 2's lower route and use its red spring to reach the life monitor on top of the loop.
levels.3: Soon after the first main loop, descend to the hazardous lower path instead of staying high. Follow it to the upward red spring, land on the loop's crown, and break the life monitor before dropping back onto the route.

levels.1: Protect your ring count and inspect nearby side paths before crossing this act's finish.

levels.1: Commit to the safer direction immediately; the opposite side ends the attempt.
levels.2: In the second rotating maze, ignore the exit tile on the left at the start and travel right through the two-bumper room.
levels.3: Enter your second giant ring with a save state made first. Move right immediately, pass the central bumpers, and cross the transparent barrier without falling toward the exit tile below. Work through a single side of both diamond layers, then enter the opening and touch the emerald.

levels.1: A falling platform can be used as an elevator to a reward below.
levels.2: On Act 3's upper route, ride the third falling platform down onto the loop-top life monitor.
levels.3: After the checkpoint, remain on the upper path until the short chain of dropping platforms. Stand on the third and let it descend rather than jumping ahead; step onto the loop below, break the life monitor, then continue from the right side.

levels.1: One lower route continues past the spring that appears to end it.
levels.2: Break the early lower wall, follow the winding tunnel, then jump beyond its final yellow spring and across the spikes into the waterfall.
levels.3: Build speed down the early lower slope and roll through the discoloured wall. Follow the enclosed route until a vertical yellow spring offers to return you upward. Do not use it: jump into the narrow space beyond, clear the spikes, and enter the waterfall pocket to break the five ring monitors and life monitor.

levels.1: Finish the local hidden checks before committing to the third act's exit.
levels.2: Complete Act 3, handle its final active obstacle, and use the outgoing capsule or transition.
levels.3: Carry at least one ring into the final active section when rings are available, complete the encounter without naming or previewing it here, then open the exit capsule or cross the physical transition. Act 3 never offers a giant-ring Special Stage, so reconcile every hidden route first.

levels.3: Enter the third giant ring and use short jumps to keep away from the perimeter exit tiles. Locate the emerald enclosure in the lower region, choose the side with the cleanest landing surface, and repeatedly rub through one narrow column of diamonds. Enter only when that gap is wide enough to prevent a rebound into an exit.

levels.1: A failed-looking fall during the lava ride reveals a useful recovery room.
levels.2: At the middle lava river, descend to the bottom-left moving block and walk through the left wall.
levels.3: Ride the main block left across the lava. If you drop near the far ledge, aim for the secondary block in the lower-left corner instead of resetting. Walk directly into the wall beside it, collect the two ring monitors and life monitor, then use that same block to return across the river.

Follow the first direction marker, continue to the second, and cross the transparent blocks into the emerald room. levels.3: Approach the final U-shaped slope with enough speed, descend without rolling, and press jump at the outer tip of the curve. Hold right in the air to clear the gap and land on the upper route; follow that ledge to its alternate finish position before leaving the act.

levels.2: From the Act 1 start, build speed and roll through the first wall on the right.
levels.3: Back away from the first wall to create a run-up, accelerate toward it, and press down before impact. The rolling attack breaks the disguised surface and drops you into a tall cache containing 30 rings and an invincibility monitor. Use the red springs behind the monitors to return to the main route.

levels.2: Pass the early moving staircase, continue right until it leaves the screen, then return after it resets into a bridge.
levels.3: Let the moving blocks descend into steps and travel far enough right to unload them. Backtrack carefully; the blocks should have restored their horizontal position. Cross their upper surface and break the life monitor that was previously sealed off.

levels.2: Stay on Act 1's lowest route, climb the alternating circular-platform tower, then run across the lowering platform near its top.
levels.3: After crossing four groups of platforms, remain below the staircase blocks and continue through the fireball gap. Climb the tall section using the alternating platform groups. At the top, ignore the platform that would lower you back to the normal road; sprint over it and jump right across the gap to trigger the concealed lower finish.

Reload this state for the second branch, enter Special Stage 6, secure the last emerald, and finish again. Do not overwrite the branch state until both ending checks are complete.

levels.1: One completion state is checked before the full collectible set is assembled.
levels.2: Use the saved branch that has fewer than six emeralds and complete the final zone.
levels.3: Load the branch where the sixth special stage was skipped, verify that the emerald display is incomplete, and finish the remaining acts without entering another giant ring. Complete the final chamber and let the entire ending sequence finish before marking this route done. Keep the five-emerald state until the second ending is also confirmed.

levels.1: The other completion state requires the entire emerald set.
levels.2: Reload the branch, collect the sixth emerald, and complete the final zone with all six held.
levels.3: Return to the pre-ring branch state, clear Special Stage 6, and confirm six emeralds on the results display. Finish the remaining cartridge route again, complete the final chamber, and watch the full ending sequence. The visible ending variation is the confirmation that this branch registered correctly.

levels.1: Enter prepared; this compact chamber contains no rings to absorb a mistake.
levels.2: Avoid the four floor pistons and strike only during the alternating machine openings until eight hits register.
levels.3: Begin with spare lives because the chamber provides no rings. Stand between piston lanes, watch which pair rises, and move only after their cycle commits. Attack the exposed machine during each safe opening, then retreat before the next pair activates. Count eight successful hits and repeat this clear on both preserved ending branches.

areas.name: Cartridge Secrets and Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: The title screen and its automatic demonstration sequence, outside normal stage play.
areas.note: These built-in modes and finite mechanic checks supplement the legitimate full-cartridge clear.

levels.1: Spend one maze attempt collecting rings before rushing its emerald.
levels.2: Collect at least 50 rings during any Special Stage to earn a continue.
levels.3: Choose a Special Stage with enough safe ring clusters, gather 50 before touching its emerald or an exit tile, and listen for the award sound. The continue remains banked regardless of how that maze ends; verify it by allowing a game-over only after a separate save state is secured.

levels.1: A later rotating maze contains enough rings for a second threshold.
levels.2: Collect 100 rings in Special Stage 2 or a later maze; Stage 1 contains fewer than 100.
levels.3: Do not attempt this in the first maze, whose complete ring supply is insufficient. In a later Special Stage, postpone the emerald, sweep the safer outer clusters until the counter reaches 100, and confirm the extra-life sound before finishing or leaving the maze.

levels.1: Large ring totals award more than protection during a single act.
levels.2: Reach 100 rings for one life, then 200 rings in the same act for the second award.
levels.3: Use an act with enough accessible rings and hidden monitors, avoiding damage because one hit drops the carried total. Confirm the first life at 100, continue collecting without leaving the act, and confirm the second at 200. These are threshold events, not items that persist in a collectible menu.

levels.1: This chosen cartridge revision adds a score milestone absent from the earlier build.
levels.2: Raise the score past 50,000 points on REV01 and confirm the extra-life award.
levels.3: Play on the audited `GM 00004049-01` build, accumulate points from act bonuses, enemies, rings, and hidden markers, and watch the life counter when the score crosses 50,000. Keep a state immediately beforehand if you want to verify the exact transition; this check is specific to REV01.

levels.1: The space around an early finish contains objects that begin invisible.
levels.2: After an Act 1 or Act 2 sign starts spinning, jump through the surrounding open space to reveal point markers.
levels.3: Use any qualifying non-final act and retain control while the spinning sign resolves. Jump at different heights and positions around the goal area; touching a hidden marker makes it visible and awards its value. Continue until you have revealed examples of the 100-, 1,000-, and 10,000-point markers.

items.label: Open Level Select and Sound Test

levels.1: The title screen accepts a short directional sequence before its demonstration begins.
levels.2: Before the demo begins, input U → D → L → R; after the ring sound, hold A while tapping Start.
levels.3: Reset and wait until the title character is visible. Enter the four-direction pattern `U → D → L → R` before attract mode starts. The ring chime confirms it. Keep A depressed while tapping Start to open Level Select and Sound Test; visit the menu without substituting it for the legitimate campaign clear.

levels.1: A longer title-screen sequence modifies the pause controls.
levels.2: Before the demo, input the pairs U+C, D+C, L+C, R+C, then start normally.
levels.3: On the title screen, enter four directional pairs in this order: `U+C · D+C · L+C · R+C`. Wait for the confirming chime, then begin. During play, pause and test each added control separately: A resets, B advances slowly while held, and C advances one frame. Preserve a normal state first so the reset test cannot cost progress.

levels.1: Control Mode has a second layer activated while an act title is displayed.
levels.2: Enable Control Mode, start an act, and hold A throughout its title card until gameplay appears.
levels.3: After the control-code confirmation, launch any act and keep A held from the title card through the first playable frame. Coordinate values and a stopped timer confirm the editor state. Press B to switch between Sonic and object control, A to cycle the available object, and C to place one; reload afterward rather than saving edited play as campaign progress.

levels.1: The unattended demonstration can receive a hidden three-button override.

levels.3: Leave the title screen untouched until an attract-mode demonstration starts. Hold all three face buttons simultaneously and observe that the recorded movement changes. Release and reapply them once to confirm the override, then reset before continuing the legitimate run.

levels.1: Reconcile the collectible row before committing the complete branch.

levels.3: Review the results display after the sixth successful maze and count all six emerald icons. Continue into a later eligible Act 1 or Act 2 with 50 rings if you need a mechanical confirmation: the exit giant ring is suppressed once the set is complete. Return to the branch state if any icon is missing.

levels.1: Use the ledger only after both branch states have reached their conclusions.
levels.2: Confirm every displayed act was cleared, both ending branches finished, and every built-in secret tested.
levels.3: Reconcile the guide area by area: clear every act through the final chamber, collect all six emeralds on the complete branch, finish the under-six branch separately, visit every documented hidden route, trigger the ring, score, and continue mechanics, and test Level Select, Control Mode, Construction Mode, and the demo override without substituting cheats for the normal clear.
